bio: Enjoy Afternoon Tea with an Asian twist at Lucy Wong, offering a tiered stand of Cantonese savouries, hand-crafted patisseries and a free-flowing teapot of your choice of Chinese tea.  Inside the venue are a selection of stylish, Asian inspired spaces. Walls are adorned with custom paintings and tapestries, and the room is complete with velour armchairs and cosy chaise lounges lit by Chinese lanterns. Afternoon Tea is served in Lucy's luxurious lounge or gallery area. The gallery is made up of traditional style dining tables with booth style seating, with a gallery of Asian inspired art works framing the wall, and lit by overhead lanterns. The lounge is comprised of low style armchairs and sofas, with ambient dimmed lighting and a relaxed atmosphere.  Served on a tiered stand for two, Afternoon Tea is comprised of Cantonese inspired savouries, including Dim Sum and mini bao, offering Asian flavours through the pork with hoisin sauce, and salmon with teriyaki sauce. The patisseries are hand-made by the patisserie chef, and include nods to Asian flavours such as pandan and yuzu. There is a patisserie dessert for everyone, ranging from the soft textures from the coconut pandan mousse, to the bitter flavours of the chocolate caramel ‘tart’ and spiced notes from the ginger apple friand. Guests also receive a free-flowing tea pot each of a Chinese or British tea of their choice from the tea menu.  Guests can now opt for Lucy’s Bottomless Spritz Afternoon Tea experience, adding 90-minutes of Bottomless Spritz cocktails - the perfect treat for summer, made to be enjoyed in Lucy’s outdoor courtyard. Guests can choose from Aperol Spritz, Miao Spritz, Sansho Spritz or the RUBY QIPÁO - a delicious mix of Chambord, Crème de Mure, Cucumber Bitters, Shiso, Prosecco and Pink Grapefruit. Combining Lucy’s love for cocktails and Afternoon Tea, Lucy Wong has collaborated with globally renowned whiskey brand House of Suntory to create a bespoke experience, with a Bottomless Suntory Afternoon Tea featuring 90-minutes of bottomless cocktails, with three premium serves to choose from.  Enjoy Lucy Wong’s Afternoon Tea for only £35 per person or upgrade to Bottomless Spritz Afternoon Tea for £55pp. Alternatively, opt for the Bottomless Suntory Afternoon Tea package with 90-minutes of bottomless cocktails for £75pp.
